## Vocabulary: Write the Word or Phrase (24 points)
Complete each sentence with the word or phrase from the chapter 1–2 vocabulary list. The Swedish cue gives the meaning. Use the list form and write the whole missing word or phrase. Check your spelling. Each gap is worth 1 point.
**10.** Cars are ______________ (ständigt) passing our house, even late at night. (1 point)
Correct answer: <i>constantly</i>
